description: This file defines an abstract class LauncherConnection that manages a network connection between a launcher server and client, handling message sending and receiving over a socket.

classes.name: LauncherConnection
classes.description: An abstract class that encapsulates a network connection, handling message communication over a socket, with methods for running, sending messages, and closing the connection.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Handles incoming messages in a loop until the connection is closed or an exception occurs.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message over the connection, with state checks and exception handling.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the connection and socket if open.
